name: Croft Coffee Roastery

location.address: No. 46, corner of Boystan-e 2 Sharghi, Farahzadi Blvd, off Darya Blvd, Shahrak Gharb, Tehran

media.alt: Croft Coffee roastery reel on specialty sourcing
Croft Coffee reel on selection and quality

description: One of west Tehran's genuine specialty roasteries across Darya Blvd from Saadat Abad: single-origin beans roasted on site, drinks at the counter plus beans and gear to take home. Minimal, coffee-first, knowledgeable baristas. Not for laptops or food; come to buy a bag and taste the roast.
